{{Quote|The ion storms of Moorja have prevented the deployment of our standard battle-droid forces, but Neimoidian Gunnery Battalions, Gossam Commandos and Koorivar Fusiliers have consolidated to provide Moorja with cost-effective protective forces.|Commerce Guild Presidente Shu Mai, regarding the deployment of Gossam Commandos to Moorja|<ref name="CIS">{{InsiderCite|76|CIS Shadowfeed Dispatch 15:3:21 Edition}}</ref>}}
The '''Gossam Commandos''' were a soldier group used by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]. [[Commerce Guild/Legends|Commerce Guild]] [[Presidente/Legends|Presidente]] [[Shu Mai/Legends|Shu Mai]] permitted the use of them personally. They also doubled as security guards.

They were [[Gender/Legends|males]] of the [[Gossam/Legends|Gossam]] species and wore heavy armor. Their primary weapon was a heavy repeating [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]]. For secondary armarment, they used a heavy shoulder-mounted cannon that took two Gossams to work&mdash;one to fire and one to reload.

During the [[Battle of Cerea]] in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], the [[Commerce Guild/Legends|Commerce Guild]] invaded the planet and Gossam commandos were responsible for the murder of [[Cerea/Legends|Cerea's]] [[President/Legends|President]] [[Bo-Ro-Tara]].

During the [[Battle of Felucia (Outer Rim Sieges)/Legends|Battle of Felucia]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], Gossam commandos were used to guard Shu Mai's compound in the capital city of [[Kway Teow/Legends|Kway Teow]], the [[Nigkoe Detention Facility/Legends|Separatist detention center in Nigkoe]], and the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist]] biomolecule facilities in the cities of [[Har Gau/Legends|Har Gau]], [[Jiaozi/Legends|Jiaozi]], and [[Niango/Legends|Niango]].<ref name="Reversal of Fortune">''[[Reversal of Fortune]]''</ref>
